description: The file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings screen, which manages user preferences such as reminders, navigates to a user profile, and displays app info. It interacts with a local database to fetch and update user data.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the settings page, allowing users to modify preferences and navigate to the profile screen.

classes.name: _SettingsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI of SettingsScreen, including fetching user data, toggling reminders, and navigating.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all user notes from the database and updates the local user list.
